resource_matching: Each arm6,701,836parameters,2048 static plus2048 MD updates,identical complete data exposure and35NFE.MD noise-progress sequences match each recipe's own MD-only counterpart.No extra training from these analyses.Actual GPU-hours differ;matched exposure is not equal wallclock.
metric_convention: Primary compare_proteins table uses residue RMSF-profile MAE;amplitude-bin supplemental table also reports atom-profile MAE.These are distinct and must not be mixed when comparing numbers.
paired_array_definition: Candidate minus reference:mean,lower,upper95percent paired system-bootstrap interval.Marginal exploratory intervals,not multiplicity-adjusted;ratios not universally lower-is-better.

external_comparisons.B_vs_hv: Bond,clash and angle improve;residue RMSF and torsion-increment errors worsen.MSD difference and all four CA full-path fair-score differences remain unresolved.
external_comparisons.B_vs_PVB: Bond,clash,MSD,angle and torsion-increment errors remain worse;residue RMSF difference unresolved.All four CA full-path fair scores improve.Retain favorable distributional evidence without claiming universal reference superiority.
external_comparisons.hv_path_pairing: B per_system path scores from edm/protein_paths100 paired with a1 entries from flow/protein_paths100_advanced using the same system_estimate and all48 matched systems;no new forecasts or marginal-CI subtraction.

high_motion.definition: Same TRAIN-frozen amplitude cutoffs and all96 conditions;high bin26conditions/18systems.No system filtering.
high_motion.interpretation: B static exposure improves bond/clash/torsion in every amplitude bin but worsens MSD in every bin.RMSF atom-profile error improves in low bin;medium/high changes unresolved.Already-suppressed high-motion amplitude decreases further in both A and B.StaticB has worse geometry,MSD and high-bin RMSF than staticA.This is not evidence that diffusion is inherently limited to small motion.

temporal_order.interpretation: B order error improves at lags1,2,8 but worsens slightly at4 versus MD-only.B versus staticA is worse at1,better at4 and unresolved at2/8.Neither has MD-like short-lag ordering;higher ordering is not universally better.
temporal_order.paired_method: Matched per_system entries of edm/temporal_order100/summary.json through molvid.evaluation.ca_detail.system_estimate.

spatial_cooperation.interpretation: B improves both covalent/contact cosine errors and relative-increment fair scores versus MD-only.B remains worse than staticA on all four observables.B versus h/v/PVB improves both cosine errors and contact fair score,while covalent fair-score differences are unresolved.Local cooperative motion can improve while whole-path distribution and MSD worsen;do not conflate these targets.

limitations: Single static followup training seed;48 repeatedly explored development systems,not independent confirmation
Additional static exposure and compute not isolated from data content without equal-resource longer-MD control
Known sequence-related development systems retained as documented in static_sequence_generalization_result.json;not family/fold independence
PVB native input and h/v pretraining/resources differ;state-only causal attribution unsupported
Native80 time response,complex64 and generated-history evidence still pending;no equilibrium or long-time kinetics claim
decision: On this seed/native100 panel staticA is preferable to staticB on main geometry/motion metrics,but no goal-level winner or default promotion.B gains chemical geometry/local coupling at a clear MSD/full-path cost;A also suppresses high motion.Complete unchanged cross-time,complex and rollout panels before choosing the next controlled architecture/training intervention.Do not infer more static exposure alone will solve dynamics or discard B universally.
